_comment: HARNESS-NATIVE example — this is the mcpServers shape a harness (Claude Code / Gemini-family settings.json) reads, NOT the Apothem profile schema shape. In the shared profile these live under mcp_servers keyed by name with a required 'transport' field (see src/apothem/schemas/profile.schema.json $defs.mcpServer). Apothem materializes this native shape from that profile.
_secret_indirection: Secret values use ${VAR} environment-variable references, never raw literals. Apothem emits a ${VAR} reference verbatim and never resolves it at render time, so no secret is written into a committable scope.
